nodes.description: Ownable._owner: privileged address controlling onlyOwner functions such as ownership transfer.
ReentrancyGuard._guardCounter: mutex counter used by the nonReentrant modifier.
ERC20._balances mapping holding principal token balances of the aToken contract.
LendingPool.addressesProvider: registry used to resolve core, data provider, parameters provider and fee provider.
LendingPool.core: reference to the LendingPoolCore contract holding all funds and state.
LendingPoolCore.lendingPoolAddress: the only address allowed to call onlyLendingPool functions.
LendingPoolCore.reserves: per-reserve state including rates, indices, LTV and aToken address.
LendingPoolCore.usersReserveData: per-user, per-reserve borrow principal, rates, fees and timestamps.
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT: EIP-1967 storage slot holding the delegatecall implementation address.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.ADMIN_SLOT: EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address.
AToken.interestRedirectionAllowances: authorizes third parties to redirect a user's interest stream.
AToken.userIndexes: per-user cumulative liquidity index used to compute accrued balances.
LendingPool.deposit: external payable, nonReentrant; mints aTokens and forwards liquidity into the core.
LendingPool.redeemUnderlying: external nonReentrant, callable only by the overlying aToken; transfers liquidity out to a user.
LendingPool.borrow: external nonReentrant; validates collateral, computes origination fee and disburses funds.
LendingPool.repay: external payable nonReentrant; repays a borrow on behalf of a user and routes fees.
LendingPool.swapBorrowRateMode: external nonReentrant; switches a user between stable and variable rate.
LendingPool.rebalanceStableBorrowRate: external nonReentrant; adjusts a user's stable rate or reverts.
LendingPool.setUserUseReserveAsCollateral: external nonReentrant; toggles collateral usage for msg.sender.
LendingPool.liquidationCall: external payable nonReentrant; delegatecalls the liquidation manager with caller supplied parameters.
LendingPool.flashLoan: public nonReentrant; transfers liquidity to an untrusted receiver and calls back into it.
LendingPoolCore.transferToUser: onlyLendingPool; sends ERC20 or ETH (raw call with 50000 gas) to a user.
LendingPoolCore.transferToFeeCollectionAddress: onlyLendingPool payable; forwards fees via safeTransferFrom or a raw ETH call.
LendingPoolCore.transferToReserve: onlyLendingPool payable; pulls tokens in or accepts ETH and refunds any excess.
AToken.redeem: external; burns aTokens and calls pool.redeemUnderlying, redirecting accrued interest.
AToken.mintOnDeposit: external onlyLendingPool; cumulates balance and mints new aTokens.
AToken.executeTransferInternal: internal; cumulates both parties' balances and performs the underlying ERC20 transfer.
AToken.redirectInterestStreamOf: external; requires msg.sender to hold the redirection allowance for _from.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.changeAdmin: external ifAdmin; writes a new admin into the EIP-1967 admin slot.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeTo: external ifAdmin; replaces the delegatecall implementation.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeToAndCall: external payable ifAdmin; upgrades then delegatecalls arbitrary calldata.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize: public payable; sets logic, admin and init data, guarded only by a zero-address check.
Ownable.transferOwnership: external onlyOwner; hands privileged control to newOwner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: public onlyOwner; sets _owner to address(0).
LendingPoolCore.setUserUseReserveAsCollateral: public onlyLendingPool; writes the user collateral flag.
LendingPoolCore.updateStateOnBorrow: external onlyLendingPool; mutates reserve and user borrow state and writes block.timestamp.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn: private; low-level call into an arbitrary token address relying on extcodesize.
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._setImplementation: internal; requires contract code then sstores the implementation slot.
msg.sender: attacker controlled caller used for authorization and state ownership decisions.
block.timestamp: miner influenced time source used for interest accrual and last-update bookkeeping.
delegatecall to addressesProvider.getLendingPoolLiquidationManager() with caller supplied arguments in LendingPool.liquidationCall.
delegatecall of arbitrary data to a freshly set implementation inside upgradeToAndCall and proxy constructors.
Raw _user.call.value(amount).gas(50000)() ETH transfer performed after state updates.
Raw feeAddress.call.value(amount).gas(50000)() ETH transfer to the fee collector.
Raw _user.call.value(excessAmount).gas(50000)() refund of surplus ETH during deposit.
Inline assembly sstore writing the new implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Inline assembly sstore writing the new admin address into ADMIN_SLOT.
External callback receiver.executeOperation(...) into an untrusted flash loan receiver before repayment is verified.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn, bypassing return-data size checks.
Arithmetic on balances, indices and rates (SafeMath and WadRayMath mul/div/ray operations) affecting accounting.
address _reserve parameter of LendingPool.deposit.
uint256 _amount parameter of LendingPool.deposit.
uint256 _amount parameter of LendingPool.redeemUnderlying.
address _receiver parameter of LendingPool.flashLoan, the untrusted callback target.
bytes _params parameter of LendingPool.flashLoan forwarded to the receiver.
address newImplementation parameter of BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeToAndCall.
Local amountToRedeem computed in AToken.redeem from _amount and the current balance.
Local localCounter snapshot of _guardCounter inside the ReentrancyGuard.nonReentrant modifier.
address _user parameter of LendingPoolDataProvider.calculateUserGlobalData, forwarded from borrow().

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the depositor whose aToken balance is checked and whose core state is updated on deposit.
borrow uses msg.sender to fetch global account data, compute the origination fee and write user borrow state.
repay requires msg.sender == _onBehalfOf when the full-amount sentinel is used, a caller-controlled authorization check.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral operates solely on the balance and collateral flag of msg.sender.
AToken.redeem cumulates, burns and redeems on behalf of msg.sender.
redirectInterestStreamOf authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with the stored redirection allowance of _from.
ifAdmin compares msg.sender against the admin slot before allowing admin-only proxy operations.
proxy initialize has no caller restriction, so any msg.sender can seize the proxy if it is still uninitialized.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender against _owner.
The deposit event records block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
The borrow event records block.timestamp used downstream for interest accounting.
The repay event records block.timestamp tied to borrow balance accrual.
flashLoan emits block.timestamp, and fee/liquidity accounting depends on timestamps in the core.
updateStateOnBorrow writes user.lastUpdateTimestamp from block.timestamp, which drives the compounded interest calculation.
liquidationCall forwards execution to the liquidation manager via delegatecall using externally supplied parameters.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls arbitrary calldata to the newly set implementation.
changeAdmin writes the caller supplied newAdmin into the proxy admin storage slot.
upgradeTo sstores a new implementation pointer, enabling full control of proxy storage.
_setImplementation writes the implementation slot after only an extcodesize check on the target.
transferToUser performs a raw ETH call to a user controlled address, allowing re-entry before the caller finishes.
transferToFeeCollectionAddress forwards ETH with a raw call to a destination taken from the addresses provider.
transferToReserve refunds excess ETH with a raw call to the depositor, an externally callable re-entry point.
flashLoan calls receiver.executeOperation before validating that the borrowed amount plus fee has been returned.
callOptionalReturn invokes an arbitrary token contract through a low-level call with optional return data.
transferToUser delegates ERC20 transfers to the SafeERC20 wrapper.
transferToUser is guarded by onlyLendingPool which compares lendingPoolAddress with msg.sender.
transferToFeeCollectionAddress is restricted to the registered lending pool address.
transferToReserve is restricted to the registered lending pool address.
deposit first mints aTokens through the aToken contract and then pulls funds via transferToReserve, an ordering that exposes cross-contract re-entry.
AToken.redeem burns first and then calls back into the pool's redeemUnderlying to release underlying funds.
redeemUnderlying updates state and then pushes funds to the user through transferToUser.
Borrow state updates perform chained additions of principals, increases and fees that must not overflow or underflow.
executeTransferInternal subtracts the transferred value from the sender balance and adds it to the receiver.
deposit drives reserve accounting and fund movement through the LendingPoolCore instance.
updateStateOnBorrow reads and mutates the reserve struct stored in the reserves mapping.
updateStateOnBorrow reads and mutates the per-user reserve data of the borrower.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which reads the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner and clears the _owner state variable.
deposit is protected by the nonReentrant mutex backed by _guardCounter.
redeemUnderlying is protected by the nonReentrant mutex backed by _guardCounter.
flashLoan is protected by the nonReentrant mutex while calling back into an untrusted receiver.
AToken.redeem reads and burns the principal balance held in ERC20._balances.
redirectInterestStreamOf authorizes the caller through the interestRedirectionAllowances mapping.
executeTransferInternal updates userIndexes via cumulateBalanceInternal for both parties.
_setImplementation writes the new address into the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant.
changeAdmin reads and writes the ADMIN_SLOT constant controlling the ifAdmin modifier.
deposit resolves the aToken and core addresses through the addressesProvider registry.
flashLoan fetches the parameters provider and token distributor through the addressesProvider registry.
mintOnDeposit adds the accrued balance increase and the deposit amount before minting.
The _reserve parameter selects which reserve state and aToken contract are touched by deposit.
The _amount parameter of deposit is the value minted as aTokens and forwarded to the core.
The _amount parameter of redeemUnderlying is checked against available liquidity and transferred out.
The _receiver parameter is cast to IFlashLoanReceiver and called with the borrowed funds.
The _params parameter is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted flash loan receiver.
The newImplementation parameter is stored and then delegatecalled inside upgradeToAndCall.
amountToRedeem is derived from _amount or the current balance and drives burns and accounting subtractions.
localCounter snapshots the guard counter so the nonReentrant check on deposit can detect nested calls.
The _user argument passed to calculateUserGlobalData determines the collateral and health factor used by borrow.

normalization_plan.reason: The _reserve parameter only exists as an input selector for deposit and should be folded into that function node.
The _amount parameter is a transient input of deposit with no independent semantic identity.
The _amount parameter is a transient input of redeemUnderlying and carries no separate semantics.
The _receiver parameter is an argument of flashLoan and is best represented as part of that function.
The _params parameter is opaque calldata forwarded by flashLoan and should merge into it.
The newImplementation parameter defines the upgrade target and belongs to upgradeToAndCall.
amountToRedeem is a purely local computation inside AToken.redeem used for burns and pool calls.
localCounter is a modifier-local snapshot of the reentrancy guard and should collapse into the guarded function that uses it.
The _user argument is supplied by borrow when requesting global account data and folds into that function.
